title: CAD IR Phase 17 — CNC tool-diameter + internal-corner rules
summary: Phased implementation plan adding cncToolDiameter field and two CNC manufacturability validation rules (min internal corner radius, pocket-too-deep) to the CAD IR.
notes: Phased implementation plan under docs/superpowers/plans/. Defines concrete type extensions, Zod schemas, rule function signatures, and validation contracts (SPEC-leaning). Could also be argued as DOC (task-list/plan prose), but the precedence rule (SPEC > DOC) and the contractual content (TS interfaces, Zod constraints, Violation shapes) tip it to SPEC. No frontmatter; no Decision/Consequences sections, so not ADR.
